question: What is the meaning of building certification in relation to health and safety aspects?
description: Building certification assesses the quality of a building, including health and safety aspects. It verifies and certifies the building's performance, allowing objective comparisons between buildings. Certification serves as a marketing tool and promotes sustainable and circular practices within the building sector.
